subject: I let you slip up before, and it cost us.

body:

# [MESSAGE FROM PRESIDENT TRUMP:](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
---
[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
Standing up for what you believe in is never easy.

Along the way, there will be challenges. You will stumble and fall, struggle, and face opposition to your progress.

The MAGA movement is no different.

Every single day, new battles arise.

**From the moment I wake up at****5 AM****, the Radical Left does everything in their power to destroy me.**

Ever since I came down the golden escalator in Trump Tower and declared my nomination for President of the United States in 2015, **__I’ve been their #1 target.__**

After all, I’m a political outsider. Untouched by the D.C swamp. Driven by one mission only: to restore this country for the people who built it.

**All I’ve ever hoped and dreamed of was to MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN.**

Yet still, the Radical Left tried everything.

[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
They came for my family and friends.

They tried to smear my reputation, they’ve created fake, scandalous stories about my past, and they even tried to destroy my future.

They used paid-for, CORRUPT judges in an attempt to throw me into prison.

**But everything they tried failed.**

**_[That’s because I made a promise to you that I will always follow. I will never waver, never falter, and never surrender in my mission to Save America.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_** **_[]()_**
From that 5 AM wake-up, I’m fighting a war every single day on behalf of every American man, woman, and child.

**For YOU and your family.**

No matter how challenging things get, I will never ask for sympathy or pity. I chose this path and it’s been the greatest honor of my life.
**Occasionally, I must ask my supporters to stand with me but I only do so when it matters most. These times are make or break moments.**

_Right now, in this critical hour, that moment is here._
**This is the moment that will define us.**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
For years, you have watched me absorb every blow without flinching. You have refused to walk away when others did.

_**[Now put your name on the line. This is the moment that will define our movement.>>](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)**_
**_[If you are still standing with me and the MAGA Movement in our most desperate hour, I, President Donald J. Trump am humbly asking you to go on the record below:](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)

Hello,
I’ll get right to it: **I’m emailing to ask you to help me defeat Lauren Boebert by making your first donation right now to my campaign.**
At midnight tomorrow, our campaign will be facing our FINAL end-of-quarter FEC deadline of the entire campaign. You’ve probably heard about these “FEC deadlines” before – and it’s for a good reason.
After September 30, our campaign is required by federal law to publicly report our fundraising totals. Everyone will scour that report. Journalists will report how much we’ve raised. The national party will take notice. Lauren Boebert will see the strength of the grassroots campaign we’ve been building. And the Super PACs will be watching, ready to pounce at any shred of weakness.
This FEC deadline isn’t just about meeting a goal to fund our campaign. It will show the world whether or not we are prepared to take on Lauren Boebert – and defend our very democracy and constitution.
Adam Frisch only lost to Lauren Boebert by 546 votes. Alright, Derek – let’s walk through this together:
Growing up, my family faced challenges that many Wisconsinites know all too well, including addiction, mental health challenges, and unstable housing. I never knew if I would come home to find our belongings on the curb from another eviction, food in the refrigerator, or a safe place to land. My parents worked hard, but it was tough.
**Luckily, I had people in my community who believed in me and gave me opportunities that changed my life.**
They helped me graduate from high school, supported my passion for public service, and helped me run for elected office. They also helped me return to college to finish my undergraduate degree while serving as Milwaukee County executive.
I’ve had an unconventional path, Derek, but my community has had my back every step of the way. **I believe every person, every family deserves that same support.**
That belief shaped my priorities as Milwaukee County executive, and it’s why I’m running for governor now. I’ve seen first-hand what happens when we put working families first:
→ When we expanded access to affordable housing, **our per capita unhoused population dropped to _the lowest in the nation_**. Now, fewer families suffer the upheaval of eviction that my family faced.
→ When we expanded healthcare access – including opening a 24/7 walk-in mental health emergency center – **our community felt the relief of _safe, comprehensive care close to home_**. That’s a resource I wish my parents would've had.
→ When we invested in public transit and local parks, **our communities thrived with new opportunities to stay connected and active.** Now, folks from backgrounds like mine have greater access to the kinds of opportunities that helped me thrive.
**But, Derek, this is just the beginning.**
I’m serious about fighting to make life better for working families across Wisconsin. I’m serious about lowering costs, funding our public schools, expanding access to healthcare and public services. I’m serious about building a Wisconsin where working people can build a life they love without leaving the state they love.
**So, Derek, my cards are on the table. You’ve seen my track record, and you’ve heard my vision for the future of Wisconsin. clean_body: I’m laying all my cards on the table so you can see my track record for yourself. | | | | During the next 35 days of this campaign, you’ll hear me talk a lot about how my working-class background shapes my vision for Wisconsin’s future. That’s not just a talking point, Derek. It’s how I govern. But I won’t ask you to take my word for it. Today, I want to lay all my cards on the table so you can see my track record for yourself. This is a longer email than I usually send, and I really hope you’ll stick around to hear my story. | | Alright, Derek – let’s walk through this together: Growing up, my family faced challenges that many Wisconsinites know all too well, including addiction, mental health challenges, and unstable housing. I never knew if I would come home to find our belongings on the curb from another eviction, food in the refrigerator, or a safe place to land. My parents worked hard, but it was tough. Luckily, I had people in my community who believed in me and gave me opportunities that changed my life. They helped me graduate from high school, supported my passion for public service, and helped me run for elected office. They also helped me return to college to finish my undergraduate degree while serving as Milwaukee County executive. I’ve had an unconventional path, Derek, but my community has had my back every step of the way. I believe every person, every family deserves that same support. That belief shaped my priorities as Milwaukee County executive, and it’s why I’m running for governor now. I’ve seen first-hand what happens when we put working families first: → When we expanded access to affordable housing, our per capita unhoused population dropped to the lowest in the nation. Now, fewer families suffer the upheaval of eviction that my family faced. → When we expanded healthcare access – including opening a 24/7 walk-in mental health emergency center – our community felt the relief of safe, comprehensive care close to home. That’s a resource I wish my parents would've had. → When we invested in public transit and local parks, our communities thrived with new opportunities to stay connected and active. Now, folks from backgrounds like mine have greater access to the kinds of opportunities that helped me thrive. But, Derek, this is just the beginning. I’m serious about fighting to make life better for working families across Wisconsin. I’m serious about lowering costs, funding our public schools, expanding access to healthcare and public services. I’m serious about building a Wisconsin where working people can build a life they love without leaving the state they love. So, Derek, my cards are on the table. You’ve seen my track record, and you’ve heard my vision for the future of Wisconsin. Now, I’m asking you to stand with me to make it a reality. Friends,
When I first launched this campaign, I didn't know much about election forecasters: people who devote their time, year after year, to studying campaigns, candidates and trends in public opinion. They try to determine which races are going to be blowouts -- and which races are going to come down to the wire.
Well, they're writing _a lot_ about Kansas these days, and I wanted to share with you directly what they've been saying about our race.
**Last week, FOUR of them -- Cook Political Report, Sabato's Crystal Ball, Fox News **_**and**_**Nate Silver 's Silver Bulletin -- announced they were moving the Kansas U.S. Senate race from "Likely Republican" to "Lean Republican" -- in other words, confirming **_**it 's going to be very close.**_
This is a big change. For some context: Earlier this year, before we launched our campaign, this race was considered Solid Republican by the forecasters. In other words, they expected a blowout.
But thanks to the strength of our campaign -- and supporters like you -- this race is on the map. Here's a bit more about those forecasters and their latest updates:
> 📣 Take Cook Political Report, for example. In explaining the reasoning behind their shift, they said _**" the agricultural economy is a major factor here, with a combination of high fuel and fertilizer prices and a trade war over beef making this race more competitive."**_
> 📣 Fox News echoed the sentiment, saying,_** "Today, Kansas joins New Hampshire and North Carolina to round out the list of nine battleground states. Kansas has been on the Democrats' radar for most of the year, thanks to [...] Adam Hamilton. He is campaigning on gas and diesel prices, which have an outsize impact in the rural and agriculture-heavy Midwest."**_
> 📣 Sabato's Crystal Ball called this one of several _**" sleeper Democratic Senate targets,"**_ then went on to say that we are the _**" most interesting" **_of those races, especially after the recent Emerson poll showed me up **" 45%-43%."**
> 📣 Nate Silver's map at the Silver Bulletin has been updated -- and you can see below where Kansas fits into the mix. This state is a major battleground.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f096717e-9ace-4678-9bd2-7ab9fbfadd40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Coming from such experts, shifts like these are huge. Kansas hasn't elected a Democrat to the U.S. Senate in almost a century, but this year, _we have a real shot at doing just that._ The _New York Times_ is calling this one of the most competitive races in the nation. Multiple polls show me ahead of my opponent, Sen. Roger Marshall. **And now, the people who make it their business to know what 's going to happen just shifted their predictions. In our favor. **_**Again**_**.**
Make no mistake: Winning this race still won't be easy, but we have a historic opportunity here, and it's all because of the support of people like you. And you know what else? With these latest ratings shifts, it's clear that many of the top election experts understand this. But we can't take anything for granted.
**As we head into the final weeks before the election, there 's no doubt that these ratings changes are a big deal. But to me, it's what's behind them -- the thousands of people like you who are fed up and ready to fight for change** _****_**-- that is the most exciting thing of all.**
**[With the final FEC end-of-quarter deadline before the election just one day away-- not to mention early voting beginning in Kansas in just a few weeks -- it's more important than ever to keep our momentum going. If you're able, will you chip in whatever you can spare to help power our movement, keep our ads on the air and stand up for Kansas and the country?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f096717e-9ace-4678-9bd2-7ab9fbfadd40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,

clean_body: Things are heating up, and I couldn't be more excited about it. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Things are heating up, and I couldn't be more excited about it. | | | Sep 29 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Friends, When I first launched this campaign, I didn't know much about election forecasters: people who devote their time, year after year, to studying campaigns, candidates and trends in public opinion. They try to determine which races are going to be blowouts -- and which races are going to come down to the wire. Well, they're writing a lot about Kansas these days, and I wanted to share with you directly what they've been saying about our race. Last week, FOUR of them -- Cook Political Report, Sabato's Crystal Ball, Fox News andNate Silver 's Silver Bulletin -- announced they were moving the Kansas U.S. Senate race from "Likely Republican" to "Lean Republican" -- in other words, confirming it 's going to be very close. This is a big change. For some context: Earlier this year, before we launched our campaign, this race was considered Solid Republican by the forecasters. In other words, they expected a blowout. But thanks to the strength of our campaign -- and supporters like you -- this race is on the map. Here's a bit more about those forecasters and their latest updates: 📣 Take Cook Political Report, for example. In explaining the reasoning behind their shift, they said " the agricultural economy is a major factor here, with a combination of high fuel and fertilizer prices and a trade war over beef making this race more competitive." 📣 Fox News echoed the sentiment, saying, "Today, Kansas joins New Hampshire and North Carolina to round out the list of nine battleground states. Kansas has been on the Democrats' radar for most of the year, thanks to [...] Adam Hamilton. He is campaigning on gas and diesel prices, which have an outsize impact in the rural and agriculture-heavy Midwest." 📣 Sabato's Crystal Ball called this one of several " sleeper Democratic Senate targets," then went on to say that we are the " most interesting" of those races, especially after the recent Emerson poll showed me up " 45%-43%." 📣 Nate Silver's map at the Silver Bulletin has been updated -- and you can see below where Kansas fits into the mix. This state is a major battleground. | | ---|---|--- Coming from such experts, shifts like these are huge. Kansas hasn't elected a Democrat to the U.S. Senate in almost a century, but this year, we have a real shot at doing just that. The New York Times is calling this one of the most competitive races in the nation. Multiple polls show me ahead of my opponent, Sen. Roger Marshall. And now, the people who make it their business to know what 's going to happen just shifted their predictions. In our favor. Again. Make no mistake: Winning this race still won't be easy, but we have a historic opportunity here, and it's all because of the support of people like you. And you know what else? With these latest ratings shifts, it's clear that many of the top election experts understand this. But we can't take anything for granted. As we head into the final weeks before the election, there 's no doubt that these ratings changes are a big deal. But to me, it's what's behind them -- the thousands of people like you who are fed up and ready to fight for change **-- that is the most exciting thing of all. ** Thank you, Adam Hamilton | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Adam Hamilton for Kansas 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

clean_body: Patriot, This isn't easy for us to do. But this is one of the most difficult emails we've ever had to send you. Here's the situation: We are less than 60 days away from the election Polling is changing daily. NONE of it can be trusted. We believe the majority in the Senate and Congress will be dangerously narrow. The media is doing everything in their power to sabotage America First candidates up and down the ballot. Turning Point PAC is funding over 600 ballot chasers in critical battleground states... But we are afraid this may not be enough to secure a conservative majority in Congress. The Radical Left's fake news machine and their fear-mongering threaten to hand Democrats control of the House and Senate in 2026. body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=241091%2E444211%2ERrDGHb)
When I get an "end of quarter deadline" request for a donation (they're filling my inbox as you read this), my eyes start to roll.
What's different about the end of the quarter versus any other day of the month?
I can't speak to all the candidates and campaigns that are bombarding your inbox right now.
But I can tell you that for Powered by People, we have a budget that dictates what I can spend on organizers, supporting volunteers, and traveling. In other words, it pays for the work of reaching, registering, and turning out the voters we need to win political power in Texas.
And this quarter, the timing couldn't be tighter. The books close tomorrow. The voter registration deadline hits six days from now. Election Day is just five weeks away. What we raise right now decides how many organizers we can keep on campuses in the final stretch, when it matters most.
We're working against the clock to reach and register as many people as we possibly can before that deadline. I'm on the road through Election Day, visiting college campuses to support our organizers:
In 2024, young Texans we met on campuses across the state turned out at a rate of over 79%! To put that in context, young voter turnout in Texas outside of our program was 39%. We're doing the work that works.

Especially now, with the resurgence of a previously eradicated disease and new measles deaths in this country, we need a pediatrician’s voice in Washington, D.C. | | Dear David, Since Primary Day on September 8th, a lot of people have asked me, "what's next?" I can tell you one thing that's certain: I'm going to do everything I can in the next thirty-five days to help Chris Pappas, Stefany Shaheen, Cinde Warmington, and every Democrat running to take back control of our State House, Senate, and Executive Council on November 3rd. In the meantime, there are all sorts of questions and proposals about what to do with the incredible community we built through this campaign. **You are a part of that, David.** For example, several prominent national politicians have approached me to ask if they can "buy my list." Basically, they're hoping I will sell them your email address and phone number, as a way to help me pay off the remaining bills I owe to some of the folks who worked with us on the campaign. Easy money, right? **I said no.** We spent fifteen months building a campaign built on trust, respect, and the radical idea that "more of the same won't fix this." Just because this campaign ended doesn't mean I'm giving up on those ideas, and your time, attention, and support is worth way more to me than what I can earn selling your data to the highest bidder _If you'd like to help us pay those remaining bills, you can contribute through[**this link**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Dm8zkj1op3chYOXThoPMvw~~/AAUS1hA~/zu-XTYElzcEimzv1BpGdgaPkHR54Oh75xd39nZx06elMtb1QMEQ7h2DgjT3S7oV5qbDHR2YkRGF0ZRV3EpDNbPgMyX1veAogT5I3gPZuAkPLxQbLoBM_IovMxvvYpg7Gd1dSWoi0ch8kGMeyWfm2hQ~~)._ I do hope you'll continue to stay in touch and follow our progress here in New Hampshire. Peter, Missouri Secretary of State Denny Hoskins is getting a rude awakening: **Voters are taking him to court and demanding $80 million in damages for violating the duties of his job as the state’s top election official.** Here’s the background: After Trump called on red states to redraw their maps mid-decade, Missouri lawmakers passed an egregious gerrymander to try to squeeze out an additional Republican seat. The people fought back and gathered enough signatures for a citizen-led ballot measure that would give Missourians a chance to vote on that map. After the signatures were submitted to Hoskins’ office, he rejected them, falsely claiming redistricting couldn’t be subject to the state’s referendum process. **The fair maps movement and citizen-activists in Missouri took this fight all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court and won — three times. Now, voters are taking Hoskins himself to court to hold him accountable.** **Let’s hope he finally gets the message: Voters are sick and tired of politicians scheming to deprive them of fair representation and fair elections.** **That’s why the NDRC exists. We are working to elect pro-democracy champions who will strengthen voting rights and shut down Republican schemes to grab power at the people’s expense.[We’ve targeted over 300 state-level races on the ballot this fall. **State of Connecticut v. State of New York and Governor Kathy Hochul**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2b714cb2-07a6-4d7f-aad4-826016ee7bec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Under the US Constitution (Article III) Controversies Among the States are resolved by the US Supreme Court.
Thanks for reading The Goldstein Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..cRUjFPg5-Ec4PHcZtROVrtRmlrnkJOs1kV9COAHdipE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=218096157)
_**Issue**_ :
New York State under the Clean Water Act is blocking the expansion of Natural Gas pipelines from Pennsylvania to Connecticut while at the same time building a new pipeline from Pennsylvania, passing through New Jersey and then delivering Natural Gas to Brooklyn, Queens and Long Island.
The pipeline will deliver 400,000 Dekatherms per day, an amount sufficient to meet the needs of 2.3 million homes. It will reduce electricity costs by $6 billion over 15 years.
While at the same time that this pipeline is being constructed, New York is not allowing the construction of the Constitution Pipeline - a 125 mile pipeline from Pennsylvania to New York where it would connect to the Iroquois Pipeline that then connects to Connecticut.
_**Background**_ :
Connecticut does not have sufficient natural gas pipeline capacity to deliver a sufficient supply of domestic natural gas to meet it's needs and currently has to purchase foreign natural gas at a significantly higher price.
CT also does not have sufficient natural gas to meet the growing needs of its residential, and business customers. _The need to import foreign natural gas raises the price of electricity to among the highest costs in the nation and almost double the average national price - a real barrier to entry to attract and/or retain businesses and residents._
New York competes with Connecticut for jobs and businesses. When the new natural gas pipeline to New York is completed, it will result in lower energy prices. It will ensure that New York will have an excess of natural gas so that homeowners and businesses will be protected from the risks of shortages and higher prices. Connecticut has no such solution.
The Problem: _**New York gives itself a competitive advantage over Connecticut. Governor Hochul 's veto of a pipeline to Connecticut from Pennsylvania is acting in an anticompetitive unlawful restraint of trade against the State of Connecticut, a competitor. It effectively boycotts Connecticut's access to more affordable domestic natural gas.**_
Time for Litigation:
The State of Connecticut should sue the State of New York for violation of the Sherman Antitrust Act and Clayton Act for unfairly restraining trade. This is an anticompetitive action by the Empire State as it builds a pipeline to meet its future energy needs and stops that pipeline from entering Connecticut, a neighboring state that competes with New York. **The Dormant Commerce Clause has been tried and has failed several times - time for a new approach.**
Relief Sought:
Connecticut should ask the Supreme Court for Injunctive Relief invalidating Governor Hochul's Constitution Pipeline veto and the State of New York for damages caused by the economic harm that has resulted from blocking by veto the construction of the Constitution Pipeline.
Pipeline Veto History:
The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) initially approved the Constitution Pipeline in 2014 that would pass through New York and bring enough natural gas to New England to cover 3 million homes. The New York Governor vetoed the pipeline. FERC has determined in August, 2026 that the 125 mile Constitution Pipeline would not significantly harm the environment. Final Federal review is due in November. However, if the expected FERC is granted, it is still subject to Hochul's veto. That is why injunctive relief is necessary to block the New York Governor from vetoing the pipeline.
Other Possible Causes of Action:
This cause of action can be combined with a Commerce Clause lawsuit against Hochul in her capacity as Governor of the State of New York.
Limitations:
This litigation can only happen if the Governor of Connecticut instructs the Attorney General to file this lawsuit. Our current Governor has not chosen to pursue legal action against Governor Hochul and the State of New York. _**This would be more productive than the current AG strategy of suing the President every week. He touts while Connecticut residents and businesses suffer and will be frozen out of the state and their homes.**_
If Connecticut wants to end the natural gas shortage we need a Governor who is willing to sue New York and not just for a meaningless press conference.
Governor Lamont has never publicly stated that he would sue Governor Hochul and the State of New York for blocking our access to affordable domestic natural gas.
_**Ryan Fazio, the Republican Candidate for Governor, should (after consultation with his legal team) publicly state what his intentions are regarding legal actions to get the Constitution Pipeline built. The other legal arguments like the Dormant Commerce Clause should be considered as well.**_
_**Connecticut should also look at holding New York hostage with the Iroquois Pipeline which requires compressor upgrades in the district of State Senator Steve Harding. This could be the joint effort of two of CT 's strongest voices for energy reform.**_
_**This is something all rational members of the Connecticut Legislature and candidates would wholly endorse. It is real affordability and opportunity for Connecticut residents and businesses. This should not be a partisan issue especially under current energy constraints and it is green energy as we do not need tankers from overseas to bring us the gas.**_

body:
Peter, it's late, so forgive me for the lack of polish.
Two things I need to tell you before the day is over:
1. A new poll from The Detroit News has us **down** 1.4 points to Mike Rogers. Nearly tied, but after millions of dollars’ worth of attack ads, things are trending in the wrong direction.
2. Our quarterly FEC deadline is **tomorrow night** , and the fundraising numbers we report shortly after are made public. We need to have a strong showing, especially after this recent poll.

Mike Rogers has $70 million and counting to blanket the airwaves with ads every day until November 3.
I’ve never taken a dime from corporate PACs, and I never will. That’s the whole reason why I'm in your inbox late on a Tuesday instead of at a fundraiser with Big Pharma lobbyists.
**I wouldn’t want it any other way, but the reality is, I have to lean heavily on members of this grassroots team to power our campaign.**
Michigan is one of the seats that decides control of the U.S. Senate. We don't get a do-over on this one.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Sorry to interrupt your nightly routine
body:
Some days, these fictional stories seem more realistic than reality.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1387&source=&t=1&akid=4016%2E124072%2EY60VX2) | | | |
---
Hi, Peter – hope I’m not interrupting your evening.
The little leisure time I get nowadays is usually spent reading before bed. It’s the one time I get to tune out the stress of real life in the pages of a sci-fi novel or legal thriller. Tonight, it’s John Grisham.
Yet with the way things are going after just two years of unchecked Republican power in Washington DC, some days, these fictional stories seem more believable than our present reality.
That’s a problem – and it’s one of many reasons why I couldn’t sit out of the U.S. Senate race here in North Carolina. Too much is at stake.
Hundreds of thousands of folks have joined us in the fight to flip NC blue for the first time since 2008, and I’m grateful: **Because ahead of tomorrow’s end-of-quarter deadline, I need all the help I can get to ensure our FEC filing shows we have the grassroots resources to stand up to the GOP’s increasingly desperate attacks and win.**
[**_So if you haven’t had a chance yet, I’d be honored if you would join us by making a donation toward our critical $5 million goal tonight._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1387&amount=5&t=8&akid=4016%2E124072%2EY60VX2)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/16105?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1387&amount=5&t=9&akid=4016%2E124072%2EY60VX2)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/16105?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1387&amount=25&t=10&akid=4016%2E124072%2EY60VX2)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/16105?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1387&amount=50&t=11&akid=4016%2E124072%2EY60VX2)
---
| | [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1387&t=12&akid=4016%2E124072%2EY60VX2)
---
My nightly routine helps me recharge ahead of long days on the campaign trail. With exactly five weeks left until our election decides Senate control and the future of our country, that’s more important than ever. _So is your support, Peter._
North Carolinians start in-person voting in 16 days, which means time’s running out to reach them with our message and bring them to our side. [**_We won’t have the resources to do that if we come up short tomorrow night, so I’m personally asking: If you can, will you chip in $5 or more to help us cross the finish line before you hit the hay?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1387&amount=5&t=13&akid=4016%2E124072%2EY60VX2)
| | [DONATE NOW](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1387&amount=5&t=14&akid=4016%2E124072%2EY60VX2)
---
Thanks for everything – have a good night,
Roy Cooper

Please note, if you have given through a spouse or another email or phone number, our records may not have transferred that information here. We are grateful for your support and no further action is required at this time._

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

# **Free Eye Screening and Glasses for Children Ages 6-17**
_**Saturday, Oct 3rd from 8AM to 1PM at Wills Eye Hospital**_ _[](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172491.172949.720&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18463)_ Clear vision is essential for a child's success in the classroom and beyond. Reserve your spot for Give Kids Sight Day at Wills Eye Hospital to get a free eye exam and free glasses for children and teens. **No insurance or prior referral is required!** If your child is struggling to see the board, has frequent headaches, or simply hasn't had an eye checkup recently, this is a wonderful opportunity to get expert, compassionate care at one of the world's leading eye hospitals- completely free of charge. **[RESERVE YOUR SPOT](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172491.172949.720&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18463)**** OR SIGN UP ON SATURDAY AT THE EVENT** _Spread the word to families, parents, and community members who might benefit._ **Let 's help every child look toward a clearer, brighter future!**
* * *
**Stay in Touch on Social Media** If you haven't visited Senator Hughes' [**Facebook page**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172491.172949.720&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18464), join the conversation by 'liking' the page and following our office on [**Instagram**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172491.172949.720&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18465), [**TikTok**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172491.172949.720&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18466), [**X**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172491.172949.720&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18467), and [**Bluesky**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172491.172949.720&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18468),. We have lots of information available on these pages about community events and issues affecting our district. If you have questions or concerns, send us an email at [**hughes@pasenate.com**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172491.172949.720&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18469).

1. We are legally required to share our fundraising numbers with the FEC and the public.
2. Sen. Marshall and his allies will study this report to see exactly how strong our movement is in the run-up to Election Day.

There are two ways this could go: If we fall short of our $1 million goal, Sen. Marshall’s corporate PAC allies will be emboldened to spend even more to dominate the airwaves in these final weeks. **But if we reach, or even exceed our goal, we’ll prove that no amount of shady money can _stop_ our momentum.**
I know $1 million is ambitious. **But we’re doing things differently: We’re raising $1 million dollars from thousands of grassroots donations from folks just like you.**
Trust me, this isn’t the easy route. **_[It’ll require each and every one of us to dig deep and give what we can.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140258792/650071649/417919962?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk199&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjYxMjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTk1YjI2MjItNzZiYy1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VtvIE8XESGzageYl1YSYdX_D0hKw-2ZY0fW6I9hS5uQ=)_** But once we get there, we will not only have the funds to fight back against massive spending by Sen. Marshall and his allies, but we will also show the country what we’re made of: thousands of grassroots supporters who believe that, together, we can build a better Kansas and a more honest, decent government for everyone.
The tides are turning. Experts have called our race a toss-up — meaning _we_ _really can win_. That’s why we’re pushing so hard in these final weeks to fight back against the millions spent against us.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Our decision
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
We knew that doing nothing wasn’t an option.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260930-1-b&t=1&akid=11879%2E3935704%2EAwH-Tm)
---
Friends, it’s Gabby Giffords.
When Mark and I were making the decision about whether to start an organization focused on gun violence prevention, we knew the challenges we would face.
Many people in D.C. said it would be political poison to stand up against the gun lobby. The NRA had millions of dollars at their disposal, and they would use every penny to drown us out. It was going to be very, very difficult.
But after the tragic shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School, which stole 20 innocent children’s lives and six staff members, we knew that doing nothing wasn’t an option.
So, we founded what is now known as GIFFORDS. And after more than a decade of hard work, we’ve made gun safety a winning issue. We’ve passed hundreds of gun safety laws across the nation and the NRA is in the weakest position it’s ever been.
I am so grateful every single day to do this work. I have never forgotten the fights we’ve taken on and won together. The amount of lives we’ve helped save — this is all because of grassroots supporters like you.
Now, we are at an inflection point. As I write this, Donald Trump’s administration is working to roll back our progress on gun safety. They are putting all of their weight towards flooding our streets with more guns and helping their gun lobby allies profit, while leaving our communities in more danger.
I know that we have what it takes to end the gun violence epidemic in our country, but I cannot take on this fight alone.
**[Tonight is our final FEC end-of-quarter deadline before the election. Can you please make a donation to support GIFFORDS PAC before the clock strikes midnight? September is a make-or-break month for us, and we cannot afford to fall behind.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260930-1-b&t=2&akid=11879%2E3935704%2EAwH-Tm)

clean_body: We knew that doing nothing wasn’t an option. Friends, it’s Gabby Giffords. When Mark and I were making the decision about whether to start an organization focused on gun violence prevention, we knew the challenges we would face. Many people in D.C. said it would be political poison to stand up against the gun lobby. The NRA had millions of dollars at their disposal, and they would use every penny to drown us out. It was going to be very, very difficult. But after the tragic shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School, which stole 20 innocent children’s lives and six staff members, we knew that doing nothing wasn’t an option. So, we founded what is now known as GIFFORDS. And after more than a decade of hard work, we’ve made gun safety a winning issue. We’ve passed hundreds of gun safety laws across the nation and the NRA is in the weakest position it’s ever been. I am so grateful every single day to do this work. I have never forgotten the fights we’ve taken on and won together. The amount of lives we’ve helped save — this is all because of grassroots supporters like you. Now, we are at an inflection point. As I write this, Donald Trump’s administration is working to roll back our progress on gun safety. They are putting all of their weight towards flooding our streets with more guns and helping their gun lobby allies profit, while leaving our communities in more danger. I know that we have what it takes to end the gun violence epidemic in our country, but I cannot take on this fight alone. # Our Community First
What service means to me Dear Neighbor, In my last email, I introduced myself and shared why I’m running for Congress. This time, I want to tell you what putting our community first has meant in my work here at home. As a Monroe County Legislator representing Gates and parts of Greece, I hear directly from neighbors about the pressures on their families. Their concerns guide the work I do and the questions I ask. |
## Here are a few ways I’ve served:
**Older adults and caregivers.** I called for increased state support for aging services so more older residents can receive help and remain safely in their homes. **Children and early learning.** I’ve spoken up for the integrity of Head Start and the early education opportunities it provides to children and families facing economic hardship. **Local planning and stewardship.** I’ve served on the Gates Comprehensive Plan Update Board and chaired the Gates Conservation Advisory Board and Climate Smart Communities Task Force, helping bring local voices into decisions about our town’s future. **Practical county oversight.** Through my work on the Legislature’s Environment & Public Works and Intergovernmental Relations committees, I review issues that affect our infrastructure, services, and taxpayers.

These are different issues, but they start in the same place: listening to people, understanding what they need, and doing the work in front of us. I want to bring that approach to representing Monroe and Ontario Counties in Congress.

## Hegseth to Cut 20% of Generals, Admirals
War Secretary Pete Hegseth will announce today a [20% cut](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAURE8DmdHHBtwEDjYh6003RMb-gHttjOwP9Nx-REtzgslKKqlU7_17jk_tvNuWvzqgojmOG17ZIxGmcceN9BI3c1CmuE9J52xiCHHkwDsGPRMwakPuxLHRpVUzIkdRoqplD7LjsmvLVZl6kgh1M8PDgpUwC9Nb3U7mAZOcp7Z06t6DXkAN0IGohKm1ES3wppdd309FA2gdxVS9ottoxdl_xRNTZWIovVqJ9lyIPwUfCj5c11XN8X1z3H3Bhz16R87kgg_4Nv7I7kS24pKRVmbjMXlkNyNbcMOkfWbaBvcJQb9iYj8iWF71fzz2Mim7X857lztZNLAE7fznDP3S4an4dwAAAP__tfSLLQ) to the positions reserved for generals and admirals, doubling the reduction he ordered last year. The cuts apply to slots, not the officers filling them now. Some jobs will be [downgraded](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUxvGngY0IDjbEA8NdvOWuHS2Cjw0VBmROE-Xtq1TqE3T-pL_0-z5uy82nnMr-3x_oaKtLwWfPSITn0rCQ32sJX9Sptvvpew_1OOoCEoyQk9By8YHSA5fB89VtiICao1N2ktaANSOPDq86mDGooKyV3m8hWKPMYDXgddw88OTePTlpqaQ0Ul90UD7oUcIwWTNNdzZIXBPV8_JZU6GIW37VB56XUA-eXSRqnel_DGYGM0WMKef3xmBuNafwYjCvuGHpyGA2SlljQUTcO1IULfvSxS9WZPQrnj2mJt5wBjM_3dqeKefUjWWD3A-ffvqc_njZw8F3AAAA__-P_4Fd) so that colonels and Navy captains can hold them, and the services have until this Jan. 1 to complete the work. Last year's order trimmed [10% of all generals and admirals](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGvnDAQhH8NdEaLzUEoKF5z3bsmRUpk7IXbBGy0u4eVfx9dlCb1q2am-TT6fnzOn552StvDHzjpmueERXZURZ5PTOq3nMJLRfO5sBcJ-TjybMH2BkbjYPZB6cK583WcVkSLrsapHUYYejv0t_o5hR47GPxg22XEG4TYL8FGCOOwRrd4qGl682B00AL04BoXWh_cDWw3Dv04LlUHGEkzNz8zJX3iuv_OF3IT8lHv01P1lMp9VPZe2XsppSmemy1flb0_sMi_MN81M-F7frBS2PG_1rXfoLu5yt71SWIK4i9DycQcDeOaw0sobYZR8osDihHkiwKaA48F2Yj6FD1HMYzRCHoT0AuuxG94zVM8C-07ST9UHWyHp_3vff2i9WuyfwIAAP__5QiZtg) and 20% of four-stars, which Hegseth summed up as "Less Generals, more GIs." The announcement lands one year to the day after he [summoned hundreds of generals](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO3SAQheGnwR0WF3zxpXCxjbvdKlJKazyMbSIMDswa7dtHmy51ytMcffp_vi_vEGJI-wecNPGWl0StRmKmslyUGPac8JMr52stUCvm88yLVtpK5aRRCyCHm5YBOj9tRJpMR9NjdGq0erTP7phW7cbniq_VO7-SVg6dHe0TEQZDuNouTN9_yhn1UMoq0xt8AJqn0oMbrXOrGBT5wLn0v3JIfNAWv_JNpcd8dnE6mK8qzJvQs9Bza61vUPo930LPH9Sq0POPAqliCRf_u4Se3woHjCT0PJjHy76c0HMlLMRQvmTeZIMiL2KSB-2V-JDgfaFaqcqdEhWIEpKXW4Rd5m0LSKVKYPn7ExIHzPLb0ZXJXy3EGKodxaD2E0L86-f_zH5P-k8AAAD__wY5moA) to Quantico and told those who didn't back his reforms to step aside. This year's audience is junior officers and enlisted troops picked for fitness and grooming standards, some of whom will work out with him.
## 30M Face Hurricane Polo Flood Risk
Hurricane Polo [made landfall](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ8GOp8W2we4cJHmuj9tSmTWy-HIeJG9dyRvH12UN0j3SSONZr4fX8tXSDmV5_dwkJeNl0JXyyRCdTmpSHhywZc04XOtoTXk4-BFgx4VOGVgCSjpTYsNffQbkSbTkx8mB9Oop_He715bPaN2zg12gBgDzbiijdNs1vu8zbpP_tMHzsAAMIK5GRwCmjto66bRubWzQDEJ19tPTkV22vJvflO9IR999rvI2TrzrdOPTj-u67qVFT8_PnmnHx_s9OPV1D-6Uonq2tPZ1EG_EnJThavsVIs6A6YtoUIOTVSTSiRNbZk5qv1Va8JQSJ2cWVUsYQSwGvrq43mlnFMbp87C8wgp_10n_yn17fWfAAAA__-QDo8i) on Mexico's Baja peninsula early Tuesday as a Category 2 with 110 mph winds, and what's left of it arrives in the U.S. today. Flash flood watches stretch from Phoenix to Des Moines, putting [more than 30 million people](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unTAQhJ_GdKDF5kcuXKShO2lTomVZwImxkb3noLz9FfcVbjfSSDP6vj-v-YU--Lj_xpOdbGmOfJfAIpzni6PgniK9pUi6loylUDrPNGvQQw22NjAjif_w3GG1uo1Zs6nYtaOFcdDj0FeHs23X46rZMAIMetuIiJcFxtHw2lNXeffsgTXQAgxgGkMtkulBd3YcrF1UB7x6Sbn5m3yUg7fwP304N5TOKrhD5CrK_FJ6Unq677uhpTwcT6_09ESlp-OdsyeMXF8ppPpCOWrJSP983OstZSYsovRUZbdetw_Bl2FUHewn-vB9JT809HH6KwAA__-VF31Z) at risk. Roads in southern New Mexico were already underwater Tuesday. Texas gets the worst of it next. Dallas-Fort Worth is looking at [1 to 4 inches](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUL3S2yAQfBrU4TkdsjCFijR0X9qUmjM6WyRIMHC24rfPKK_wdTuzO_v362v-opji_vxJG0_yyPPOR0sswnUuvAs98x5e0iSXe6XWQt62PCPgqMFpAzMFiW-eB-qW6cGMbDqeeuvAjmjHa7dO_ZUWe-cbs0EXFvsYenslNKG_sR0ddHE6_cAZ6AFGMBcTegrmCjg4Ozp3VwPwEiXXy-8cd1n5kT75zfUS8talaRUpTZkfCr1CfxzH5dVI8kKfU6DQN8n1c1JMsnJV6M9AhR7ciW8K_fqqNQbaWZecspZK4Q9XXUhW3Qo9VxaJessLp6aF_1LTnHShlhV617vbOQrAKvRdnZZyxJRiG60a4LlRTP-ryjcffk_4LwAA__-lkI92) starting today and running through Thursday. Polo peaked at 180 mph over the weekend, tied for the third-strongest storm ever recorded in the eastern Pacific. It went from 45 mph to 150 mph in a single day, a jump forecasters called "[truly remarkable](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7CAUBOCnwd2iw88aU1Dcxt3eNqXFwrFNhMEyZ23l7aON8gapRppiPmk-HtPDp5zK8t9v6GiuU8GrZSTCY9qxkF9qCS9qVPfn4VsLddvqJEH2N7A3BZMPlE6ctO-imxElqg6dMBZML01_71YX_DBbY7WIchBRaXUfVNRzEL0QSgy6S-69B1aBAOhBcRWED-oOUlvTW_tkGjAmqgf_rKnQinP-qicePNSty24l2htT_5gcmRyv6-JlDbxU7_lSTyZHf4Q1ncjk-IaYHHEX5jfeDY-phVfjAIa3lbbcHS7uV8o5td4wDcvmU_7R6I8nnU5-BwAA___QFHko)."
## Protests Send Evicted 87-Year-Old Home
An 87-year-old woman, who was carried out of her Madrid, Spain, apartment after 70 years, is [going home](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHOnDAQxfHTQDerwWbx58JFmu02bUo02MPiyNjInoD29tEmuUHqv_TT0_vxnJ8UU8yv77Szk7XMma-WWITrfHAWepXsf0mTciyVWvNl38usUE2AFjTO5CWePI_UB7cyK9Y9u8FYNJMy073fnKKgiEhbtZBZFtTG6kBMnsPXPXjqo_t4aDUOiBPqm_YDeX1HNVozWbt0I3KIUurtZ4lZNl7Tu5xcb77sfXKbyNE6_a1Tj049Di5H4k_q1OMqO2X4MsBn9MIBaBWuYAZ4M9UGlFK5OMBWdv7XMlNNbxgQEBH-anDUItwEYgbZGJpUZmkwqGGcDOq-unBcMaXYJtON-Noppj_r5D9PPZ36HQAA__-8oY3e) after thousands of people flooded her neighborhood in protest, her lawyer said Monday. Maria del Carmen Abascal moved in at 17 and paid about $570 a month until an investment fund bought the building in 2018 and raised her rent to more than $3,000, significantly more than her monthly pension. Police carried her out on a stretcher on Sept. 23 after giving her 30 minutes to pack. Crowds chanting _"Shame on you"_ filled the streets that night; 25,000 marched Saturday, by the police count, and tents took over Madrid's main square. [See the protest camp here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSnSAQhZ8GO-6s4JWfgiKN3Z82pYOw6mYEHNirk7fPmFdIt8U3355zfn3P354OyttPn9DxWuaMdzuQGet8Yma_lRw-3LicS_WthZJSmRWoUYKVGmYfmC6cB99FtyIq1B263lgwozLju9udNhZAQQ_v94qxN0sfxkFF-FpM_IqD6cg9PrAaeoAR9EuH3gf9BjVYM1q7iAEwEpf6-l0o847r8adcWF-hpO5wO_PZhP4h1CTUdN_3Cz-1PEUeQKjpoohFqOl5I9QE9rnNw3oOu0y-NZl8rBTlWQtj4yYfv0y-UvA1YZZ4UWAqWfoc5V4-jfImQ6VGrasunjcdB7XRiAG25On4l43_c9LLqb8BAAD__5a0jIk). Under the deal, her rent is capped at 30% of her income for eight years, [no more than the $570](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUL2OpDAMfprQZRQCm0yKFNfQ7bVXIk8wg29DjBLPoH37E_sK11jWp0_f35_P-RMoU3n-hh2jrDwXPFtGEazzgUXgySW9pAkfjwqtJd53nq2xTpugBzNDEnrjPEK3xBXR4tBh7H0w3lnvProtOtM_7uEObukHt7rg1-BGGD32DlZYoaN46ZkwmN4YZ4bbkHpIw4exY_AuhIcaDS4kXG9_mYpsuOZvfmO9Jd67HDeRo6nhl7KTstN5nreUKX3ZjV9NuFwsZaermLLTZaXsZML1XweKvnv9jVA150WfvEPR58YNNb4pCXHR7YD6hYs-Kgs2aZp-MCqamq4or1qoPPXGOyo7dTUux0k5U3Nejea5A-WfrPKfE7-j_RcAAP__vsaR3Q) she paid before. She will sign once she leaves the hospital, where she is being treated for exhaustion. On Tuesday, Spain's government proposed eviction protections through 2030 and a ban on "vulture fund" purchases.

name: Cooper, Roy
subject: You grabbed my attention
body:
I want to express my profound gratitude for having you by my side.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1388&source=&t=1&akid=3974%2E124072%2Ejo9yhc) | | | | | | Peter, I’m not reaching out to everyone today – just a select few, including you.
---
| | My team was going through our supporter records, and yours stood out in the crowd. You’re one of my most attentive grassroots supporters. You’ve been getting these emails for a while now, and we see you're keeping up with the latest on this election. I want you to know that I know how engaged you’ve been with our campaign and how much I appreciate it. [**_Today, I’m asking you to take the next step._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1388&amount=5&t=9&akid=3974%2E124072%2Ejo9yhc) **Here’s why:**
---
| | Grassroots fundraising has stalled these last few weeks, and it couldn’t come at a worse time. Republican super PACs have poured more than $100 million into North Carolina to defeat me, and President Trump and JD Vance have both come to smear my name at rallies alongside my MAGA opponent Michael Whatley.
---
| | With two recent polls showing the race statistically tied, we need to turn this around fast – and the first step is reaching our $5 million end-of-quarter goal by midnight. [**_Will you chip in $5 right now to help us get there in time? The stakes could not be higher._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1388&amount=5&t=10&akid=3974%2E124072%2Ejo9yhc)
---
| | North Carolina is the best chance Democrats have to flip one of the four red seats we need to take back the Senate. **If we lose here, we lose our shot at flipping the majority.** The only way to avoid that is by building the resources to compete with the GOP’s massive spending.
---
| | **Unlike my MAGA opponent Michael Whatley, I’m not a Washington DC insider who can rely on his billionaire connections to buy this Senate seat. I’m depending on people like you giving what you can, when you can, at crucial moments like this.**
---
| | _With less than 24 hours left to close the gap, Peter, I need you._
---
| | **Since time’s running out, my team wanted me to reach out to engaged supporters like you – so I’m personally asking:** [**_Will you please chip in your first $5 donation to my campaign today so we can reach our last FEC end-of-quarter goal before the election, flip North Carolina’s seat and help Democrats secure the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1388&amount=5&t=11&akid=3974%2E124072%2Ejo9yhc)
---
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1388&amount=5&t=12&akid=3974%2E124072%2Ejo9yhc)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1388&amount=25&t=13&akid=3974%2E124072%2Ejo9yhc)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1388&amount=50&t=14&akid=3974%2E124072%2Ejo9yhc)

Roy

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1388&source=&t=3&akid=3974%2E124072%2Ejo9yhc)

name: Opal
subject: Opal is graduating to skills in Gemini
body:
| | | Hi everyone, Today, Google announced skills in Gemini – a faster way to automate repetitive tasks and save custom instructions right in chat. As skills offers many of the same capabilities as Opal, our AI workflow experiment, we'll be turning Opal down on November 17, 2026. Whether you used Opal to build AI mini-apps on [opal.google.com](https://c.gle/AAuDWvm22f0-K7mT4062gpbvDlGewlct13WuCw2FNxkYq_Qp0RMDY312K4_TYP2FZZgiuP3z8VYWdDjfpaj7a49ru2I5GEsBsigB2ElgKQfVZKN2JxGhArM) or within the Gemini app, your creativity taught us a lot about how people want to customize AI. Everything we learned from this experiment directly helped shape how skills work today.
### Where to keep building
While saved workflows will not automatically migrate, you can explore our core platforms to continue building:
* **For everyday tasks and customized chat:** We invite you to try [skills in Gemini](https://c.gle/AAuDWvkoIWltTzoxhaE0Biyzd5oPn-7d4beDbwM2mYMqVjpKboEZudzDIF52kDEcHvu0DD0DLHQn14IgC5MDEEgOf1bRj3K1lSQBBpICksFS0S_xrcaC6dcKmHx3hxXnfTX3CcMDiYIgUwKgkoDLg3d8_E69JZORKiAAdlT8BqJSqhUc5bfYC2cBzrxLt791N8ATTc91irU). Just save your repeating instructions as a skill, and call it up anytime in chat by typing a forward slash (/) followed by your skill's name.
* **For deeper prototyping and developer projects:** We recommend checking out [Google AI Studio](https://c.gle/AAuDWvlIcOmpmsnJfZveVyyQ6Qvuo_lc-lu1JyOeRXVS4QJKCdawESqR0dzz6WUZgGCi-Fidm5s2AAQyAMzs-o7j62p9I_jxFyS_VswmEeBWlxTupdxucIHm8eY), where you can build directly with our newest Gemini models using custom prompts and advanced AI features.

### What happens to your saved files
* **Your files stay with you:** Because our workflow creator saves directly to your personal [Google Drive](https://c.gle/AAuDWvn3bm-xsRsfrpkrcLnAacsyU0v21judLa-7zfxf0KSGejQjp8UzE2ANWrOckXcLlIFqjVi-rhsHv0l8RMf2u8ODUOgkWB8kea82Fn7jymAo_zZngnU), all your saved workflow files live inside a folder named "Opal" in your Drive (My Drive > Opal). We won't touch or delete these files during shutdown. However, because the visual runner will turn off after November 16, workflows will no longer run interactively. If you have custom prompts you want to keep, we recommend opening your workflows on [opal.google.com](https://c.gle/AAuDWvm22f0-K7mT4062gpbvDlGewlct13WuCw2FNxkYq_Qp0RMDY312K4_TYP2FZZgiuP3z8VYWdDjfpaj7a49ru2I5GEsBsigB2ElgKQfVZKN2JxGhArM) and copying the prompt text before November 16.
* **Continued access until November 17:** You can keep using [opal.google.com](https://c.gle/AAuDWvm22f0-K7mT4062gpbvDlGewlct13WuCw2FNxkYq_Qp0RMDY312K4_TYP2FZZgiuP3z8VYWdDjfpaj7a49ru2I5GEsBsigB2ElgKQfVZKN2JxGhArM) and Opal features within the Gemini app as usual to build and run workflows until November 16.

For more details and instructions on downloading your workflow files, please visit our [Opal FAQ](https://c.gle/AAuDWvkg9lnKJx4d9n8SZbITwxG_y6zr3eQ89r0Wr60KQ-pH4P-O0YQ5u6bjKjmLeOp8I-LLcix1qmSY_YVjCzkeSE51PHZdsG5ejiqu_3NHxYYVknjyMohE-9rTyGgbQUIxhvgY1X8). Thank you so much for building and innovating with us during this experiment! The Google Labs Team
* * *
You have received this mandatory service announcement to update you about important changes to your Google Labs Opal account. ©2026 Google LLC, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043
---

body:
| | | | Good morning, Peter! It’s Cait. I only have a few spare moments this morning before the day gets going, so please forgive the lack of polish here. Two things for you before you start your day:
1. Our last quarterly FEC deadline is tonight at midnight, and the fundraising numbers we report are public. It’s important that we show we have the resources to compete, especially with more dark money coming in every day.

Sadly, we’re seeing a resurgence of this destructive ideology right here in the United States.

| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcGKpDAQQL8m3pSYqNGDh2HthoWdGRYPy5wkk6rWgpgEU_bu5y_N9v7AXN8rXkHVr9fl1ZKnsL7ZHUfKeYEIi4vhdsTAvOFujz-U2RPmGHhRUnWlHEotF-uY7rg0toCxVXV_6wscazNI0w29bIttNF0j3Q2Gtqub_ja49rNzbuhMbaEHZaCg8dGTg5a1klqpqja17q0zrUX4NBJEI88ElrGikAkwuxhTip6YXK7isRZ-3JhTFvpFqKtQ14zuPLDayPsM1mOFcAp1hRgs48OfKcWDS96wJE8WhL5mXHcM_C0CCj1JLWv9JlWjflym6X26XGahupP3JcfzcI-RdMSc0DGF9al2BDp3oSfcLfkndHZPltYg9PRv1RPHwBhY6Ol9-pjny8cyvSw_Tfl9nsv_9yiOEdJv8p5yZ0Qj10e2cnEv-Ktfuo_qbwAAAP__cc2jkg)

| | Dear Fellow American, **Is human nature fixed, or can it be changed?** That question lies at the heart of some of the most consequential ideas in history. Karl Marx believed that if society could be upended, mankind itself could be remade. That promise inspired revolutionary movements throughout the twentieth century—with catastrophic consequences, as communist regimes claimed the lives of more than 100 million people. **Sadly, we’re seeing a resurgence of this destructive ideology right here in the United States.** But anyone who’s read Homer understands something far different. Nearly **3,000 years ago** , _The Iliad_ portrayed men and women with the same hopes, fears, loves, jealousies, ambitions, courage, and grief that we recognize today. Open its pages, and you discover something remarkable: **Human nature has not changed.** Near the end of the poem, King Priam of Troy enters the camp of Achilles, the warrior who killed his beloved son Hector. The old king kneels before his enemy and begs for his son’s body. Achilles thinks of his own aging father, and both men weep together. Every parent understands that scene. Every son can understand it. Across three millennia, Homer reminds us that what is deepest in human nature remains the same. That is why _The Iliad_ has endured as one of the foundational works of Western civilization. And it is one reason Hillsdale College created our free online course, **“The Iliad.”** The course introduces students to truths about courage, honor, sacrifice, friendship, justice, and duty—truths that every generation must rediscover if liberty is to endure. Those same truths also expose the false promise behind every utopian ideology: **that human nature can somehow be perfected simply by changing politics or economics.** **Will you make a tax-deductible gift today to help us introduce 100,000 Americans to these timeless lessons through Hillsdale’s free online course on _The Iliad_?** Will you help? Your gift of $25, $50, $100, or even $200 or more will go a long way toward this effort. **Please make your best, tax-deductible gift today using this secure link:** [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/donate/support-the-iliad**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcGKpDAQQL8m3pSYqNGDh2HthoWdGRYPy5wkk6rWgpgEU_bu5y_N9v7AXN8rXkHVr9fl1ZKnsL7ZHUfKeYEIi4vhdsTAvOFujz-U2RPmGHhRUnWlHEotF-uY7rg0toCxVXV_6wscazNI0w29bIttNF0j3Q2Gtqub_ja49rNzbuhMbaEHZaCg8dGTg5a1klqpqja17q0zrUX4NBJEI88ElrGikAkwuxhTip6YXK7isRZ-3JhTFvpFqKtQ14zuPLDayPsM1mOFcAp1hRgs48OfKcWDS96wJE8WhL5mXHcM_C0CCj1JLWv9JlWjflym6X26XGahupP3JcfzcI-RdMSc0DGF9al2BDp3oSfcLfkndHZPltYg9PRv1RPHwBhY6Ol9-pjny8cyvSw_Tfl9nsv_9yiOEdJv8p5yZ0Qj10e2cnEv-Ktfuo_qbwAAAP__cc2jkg) Today, more young Americans express favorable views of socialism than at any time in recent decades. Too many have never encountered the great books that reveal why attempts to remake human nature have always failed. **Education is the answer.** Through more than **50 free online courses** , Hillsdale College is introducing millions of Americans to the principles of liberty and the enduring truths of Western civilization. Like everything we do, this course was created **without accepting a single penny of taxpayer funding—not even indirect funding through student grants and loans.** That independence allows Hillsdale to teach the truth without political interference. But it also means we rely entirely on friends like you to carry these lessons to the Americans who need them most. Thank you for standing with Hillsdale College as we pursue truth, defend liberty, and help another generation discover one of civilization’s greatest books. Warm regards, Bill Gray ’01
Vice President

Hillsdale College

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Dear Fellow American, Is human nature fixed, or can it be changed? That question lies at the heart of some of the most consequential ideas in history. Karl Marx believed that if society could be upended, mankind itself could be remade. That promise inspired revolutionary movements throughout the twentieth century—with catastrophic consequences, as communist regimes claimed the lives of more than 100 million people. Sadly, we’re seeing a resurgence of this destructive ideology right here in the United States. But anyone who’s read Homer understands something far different. Nearly 3,000 years ago , The Iliad portrayed men and women with the same hopes, fears, loves, jealousies, ambitions, courage, and grief that we recognize today. Open its pages, and you discover something remarkable: Human nature has not changed. Near the end of the poem, King Priam of Troy enters the camp of Achilles, the warrior who killed his beloved son Hector. The old king kneels before his enemy and begs for his son’s body. Achilles thinks of his own aging father, and both men weep together. Every parent understands that scene. Every son can understand it. Across three millennia, Homer reminds us that what is deepest in human nature remains the same. That is why The Iliad has endured as one of the foundational works of Western civilization. And it is one reason Hillsdale College created our free online course, “The Iliad.” The course introduces students to truths about courage, honor, sacrifice, friendship, justice, and duty—truths that every generation must rediscover if liberty is to endure. Those same truths also expose the false promise behind every utopian ideology: that human nature can somehow be perfected simply by changing politics or economics. Will you make a tax-deductible gift today to help us introduce 100,000 Americans to these timeless lessons through Hillsdale’s free online course on The Iliad? Will you help? **Tonight 's FEC end-of-quarter deadline is the most important of the entire campaign.**
Let me explain:
Tonight at midnight, we face our final end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day. Our campaign set a $1 million fundraising goal to keep us on track for the final stretch, and here's why:
📊 Republican John Sununu is surging ahead in the polls.
📡 National Republicans are outspending us 3-to-1 on the airwaves.
🗳️ Every dollar that we raise today determines what we can budget for the final 34 days until Election Day.
If we fall short now, we risk letting Republicans not only flip this seat but lock up the Senate majority for a generation.
Granite Staters' hard-earned Social Security. Lowering the cost of healthcare. Reproductive rights.
**That 's what's on the line.**
We can protect these priorities by beating Sununu in November. But only if we raise the resources we need to compete.
**[I'm directly asking you: Will you chip in $15 to help us reach our end-of-quarter goal of $1 million and keep this seat from falling into Republican hands?](https://substack.com/redirect/e8cd55cc-51e3-4c85-b857-e522672030a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

This $1 million goal isn't arbitrary -- it's what we need to compete and win over the next five weeks.
If you're able to help us reach it tonight, it would be a massive help to everything we're trying to accomplish. **[I would be very grateful for your $15 contribution.](https://substack.com/redirect/e8cd55cc-51e3-4c85-b857-e522672030a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Chris

It's 8:00 a.m. here in Washington, D.C. and I'm already writing to you _because today matters that much._ Today's the last day of the quarter, which means your inbox is probably flooded with emails right now. I get them too. Honestly, I haven't even opened my own inbox yet this morning, and I already know it will be packed with asks. I know that you can't give to everyone. But if you're considering making a donation to help Democrats win this November, I hope you'll choose EMILYs List. Here's why: Democrats cannot take back power this year without electing women up and down the ballot. EMILYs List has spent decades building the infrastructure, perfecting the training, and growing the early support that has helped women candidates compete and win in some of the toughest races for the last 40 years. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE MassGOP Research Department
The Dirty Dozen: 12 Times No Transparency Exposed Total Lack of Government Accountability
One-party government is the enemy of transparency. When one party holds the legislature, the corner office, and most local power for years, audits get delayed, records get withheld, and contracts start looking like a club. That is not left versus right. That is what happens when nobody in power has to answer to a real opposition.
Maura Healey, Senate President Karen Spilka, Speaker Ron Mariano and the Democrat Super Majority on Beacon Hill have ignored so many stories exposing corruption under their noses and have done nothing about it.
Any other state and just one of these instances would have caused outrage. But in Massachusetts, it is just another week, another scandal.
In November 2024, 72 percent of Massachusetts voters demanded an audit of the state legislature and made it the law. Two years later, it still has not happened.
The state has also refused to turn over SNAP and Medicaid records, while posting the highest SNAP error rate in New England. The Auditor has fought for the audit. Most of the political class has not.
Here are the Dirty Dozen times government has lacked accountability:

1. $2 billion in estimated rent over 40 years (up to 60 with options) on a Springfield courthouse awarded as a $600 million build-and-lease-back to a team tied to Conan Harris, husband of Rep. Ayanna Pressley, over experienced local contractors. Defended by Healey and Andrea Campbell
2. $1.75 billion, 35-year MassDOT highway-plaza contract awarded in 2025 to Ireland's Applegreen, a major donor to Governor Maura Healey, over Waltham-based Global Partners, whose bid was reportedly about $900 million lower than Applegreen's. The bid process was later found improper.
3. $4 billion economic-development bill signed by Governor Maura Healey in November 2024 included Section 269, granting BlueHub Capital retroactive-style immunity from consumer-protection claims after homeowners alleged the firm's "shared appreciation" mortgages took 40-60 percent of home appreciation. BlueHub's CEO is a longtime friend, donor, and fundraiser for Governor Maura Healey.
4. $250 million Boston housing award in 2024 from Mayor Wu's planning department to a Conan Harris-tied project--before the Springfield courthouse deal.
5. $7 million alleged SNAP store-reimbursement fraud: two Boston men charged in December 2025.
6. $1.6 million in COVID-era small-business loans Lawrence Mayor Brian DePeña was arrested in 2026 for allegedly diverting to personal and campaign expenses.
7. $1.4 million SNAP/MassHealth/disability fraud sweep: 15 people charged in June 2026.
8. $1.1 million alleged multistate SNAP/PUA identity-theft scheme: four people charged in February 2026.
9. $943,000 in losses from a related benefit-fraud crackdown: nine people charged in March 2026.
10. $36,000 State Rep. Christopher Flanagan was indicted in April 2025 for allegedly stealing from a Cape Cod trade association he ran, with additional charges in 2026.
11. $7,000 cash kickback Boston City Councilor Tania Fernandes Anderson took from a staffer's city-funded bonus in a City Hall bathroom. She pleaded guilty, resigned, and was sentenced.
12. LaMar Cook, deputy director of Governor Maura Healey's Western Massachusetts regional office, was arrested in October 2025 after state police intercepted cocaine shipments totaling 21 kilograms tied to deliveries at the Springfield State Office Building.

Why one-party rule hurts everyone. Without a real check, the majority has no incentive to open the books, enforce its own audit law, or explain why connected bidders beat local ones.
Corruption is not a partisan brand, but it grows in the dark with one party rule. Massachusetts does not need more loyalty tests. It needs records, competitive bidding, and officials who treat a voter-mandated audit as the law; not a suggestion.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: This decision wasn't easy
body:
I can’t do this alone, Peter.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1389&source=&t=1&akid=3975%2E124072%2EuvCMF1) | | | |
---
Peter, I’m in a bit of a bind.
A new poll shows that our race is now statistically tied, and the Senate GOP’s top super PACs are currently outspending us to boost my Republican opponent. That’s because Senate control hinges on this battleground race.
Since I’m running a grassroots campaign, I can’t fight back without you. So if you’re able to chip in a few bucks to power our fight before our final FEC end-of-quarter deadline tonight, I’d really appreciate it. Here’s the link to donate:
[**_https:/ /secure.actblue.com/donate/cvf-email-26_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1389&amount=5&t=8&akid=3975%2E124072%2EuvCMF1)
Now, my decision to run for Senate wasn’t made lightly.
Serving as Governor was one of the great experiences of my life, but after my second term, I was ready to hang up my suit and tie. From adding hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs to giving school teachers much-needed raises to expanding access to Medicaid, **my #1 priority was to improve the lives of everyday people – and we did that.**
That’s why it’s so upsetting to see how Washington DC insiders have turned their backs on hardworking people. Insiders like Michael Whatley, my opponent in this race.
My opponent says he’ll lower costs, but he built his career promoting the interests of Big Oil and utility companies at the expense of working families. He says he’ll protect our communities, but as chair of the state GOP, he appointed a convicted child sex offender who served six years in prison to powerful leadership roles within the party because he could raise money. He claims he’ll fight for North Carolinians, but it’s clear that **_his_ priority is choosing himself and his wealthy friends.**
_It’s no wonder why the President anointed him to run after Thom Tillis bowed out of running for this seat._
So while I didn’t plan to go to Washington DC, I couldn’t stand by and watch the GOP rip away health care access, gut resources for public education and chip away at the middle class. They are not making this country “great again.”
I had to get back in the fight, and I’m so glad I did.
Ever since launching this campaign, hundreds of thousands of folks like you have joined our grassroots movement for change, and momentum is on our side.
The hard part will be maintaining it for the next five weeks or so left in this race.
Republicans are spending more than $100 million so far to turn voters against me and save their Senate majority – and this surge of dark money is taking a toll on our narrow polling lead.
We can fight back and win in North Carolina, but just as in elections past, I can’t do it alone.
**[_Please, Peter – with just hours left to hit our ambitious $5 million end-of-quarter goal, will you chip in what you can today to help me flip this seat, retake the Senate for Democrats and return power in Washington DC to the hands of working families?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1389&amount=5&t=9&akid=3975%2E124072%2EuvCMF1)**

body:
|

| |
---
|
---
| **Know Before You Vote Vol. 1: **
**Amanda Janoo Opposes the Vermont Air National Guard’s
158th Fighter Wing**
There are very few things that nearly EVERY major office holder in Vermont agrees on. But keeping the Air National Guard in Vermont is one of them.

Senator Patrick Leahy and Governor Jim Douglas were both champions for keeping our fighter wing in Vermont. Since the older F-16s were replaced with modern F-35s, Sen. Bernie Sanders, Sen. Peter Welch, Gov. Peter Shumlin and Gov. Phil Scott have all also supported their stationing here and continuing the mission of the air guard in Vermont.

_It's an important fact to note ... if there are no F-35s, there is no Vermont Air National Guard. Vermont can't have an air wing without aircraft._

So, where does Amanda Janoo stand ... what would she do?

Back in August she told an activist group called _Cancel the F-35s,_ in her own words _:_

**_“ _If there’s anything I can legally do as Governor to get them out of our skies, I’m down.”__** [**_[1]_**](https://us.list-manage.com/X528oEQoT81?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c "#m_-5665332061540639243__ftn1")

The Air National Guard supports more than 1,000 direct jobs, accounting for over $60 million in pay and benefits. [[2]](https://us.list-manage.com/P1bn5NO_bOq?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c "#m_-5665332061540639243__ftn2")

Our National Guard members serve our communities in times of need, from the pandemic to floods and cyber-attacks. They are irreplaceable and we can’t simply cast them aside.

They also serve a strategic national security mission. As many remember, in the hours after the 9/11 attacks, it was the Vermont Air National Guard securing the airspace above Ground Zero.

Vermont just welcomed them home after multiple difficult deployments, with deep gratitude for their sacrifice and service.

As a candidate to be their Commander-in-Chief, Amanda Janoo posted a flashy social media video, without ever acknowledging her real opinions on having this unit in our National Guard.

Amanda Janoo's opposition to the Air National Guard sets her apart from most Democrats, Independents and Republicans.

Governor Scott is a governor who understands the importance of the National Guard and who will support them, not "get them out of our skies."

Stay tuned for Vol. 2 of **Know Before You Vote...**

**\- Team Scott **
###

clean_body: | | | | | Know Before You Vote Vol. 1: Amanda Janoo Opposes the Vermont Air National Guard’s 158th Fighter Wing There are very few things that nearly EVERY major office holder in Vermont agrees on. But keeping the Air National Guard in Vermont is one of them. Senator Patrick Leahy and Governor Jim Douglas were both champions for keeping our fighter wing in Vermont. Since the older F-16s were replaced with modern F-35s, Sen. Bernie Sanders, Sen. Peter Welch, Gov. Peter Shumlin and Gov. Phil Scott have all also supported their stationing here and continuing the mission of the air guard in Vermont. It's an important fact to note ... if there are no F-35s, there is no Vermont Air National Guard. Vermont can't have an air wing without aircraft. So, where does Amanda Janoo stand ... what would she do? Back in August she told an activist group called Cancel the F-35s, in her own words : “ If there’s anything I can legally do as Governor to get them out of our skies, I’m down.” [[1]]( "#m-5665332061540639243ftn1") The Air National Guard supports more than 1,000 direct jobs, accounting for over $60 million in pay and benefits. [[2]]( "#m-5665332061540639243ftn2") Our National Guard members serve our communities in times of need, from the pandemic to floods and cyber-attacks. They are irreplaceable and we can’t simply cast them aside. They also serve a strategic national security mission. As many remember, in the hours after the 9/11 attacks, it was the Vermont Air National Guard securing the airspace above Ground Zero. Vermont just welcomed them home after multiple difficult deployments, with deep gratitude for their sacrifice and service. As a candidate to be their Commander-in-Chief, Amanda Janoo posted a flashy social media video, without ever acknowledging her real opinions on having this unit in our National Guard. Amanda Janoo's opposition to the Air National Guard sets her apart from most Democrats, Independents and Republicans. Governor Scott is a governor who understands the importance of the National Guard and who will support them, not "get them out of our skies." Here's why I think ours is worth reading, Derek.
A lot of those campaigns are running in states where the outcome is clear. A slow quarter stings, but it doesn't decide anything.
But that's not where we are in the most competitive battleground state in the country.
In 2016, Donald Trump won Pennsylvania by one percentage point. In 2020, Joe Biden won it by one. In 2024, Republicans won a Senate seat here by 0.22%.

A few days ago we asked if you could chip in $2.
#
Peter, a few days ago we asked if you could chip in $2.
We couldn’t convince you, and that’s alright. Maybe it wasn’t the best time. Maybe it was the wrong amount. Maybe something else.
Whatever it was, we want to make sure you know that every donation matters ahead of this final quarterly FEC deadline of the year. So, we’re going as low as we can.
[**We’re asking if you can chip in $1 for VoteVets.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep26.f1bOKp&refcode=em26030-1-180&t=1&akid=35642%2E3013755%2EWqK1s-)

| [CHIP IN MORE](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep26.f1bOKp&refcode=em26030-1-180&t=3&akid=35642%2E3013755%2EWqK1s-)
---

$1 because after this deadline we’re in a full sprint to Election Day.
$1 because we have millions of dollars committed between now and then.
$1 because any donation helps us cover that cost — yes, even $1.
And, yes, $1 because we’re hoping just about anybody could afford that. If you can give more we’d be so grateful, but $1 is all we ask today.
[**Can you do it? Please, chip in that $1 and help us put an absolutely massive number of individual donations on our FEC report after this deadline.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep26.f1bOKp&refcode=em26030-1-180&t=4&akid=35642%2E3013755%2EWqK1s-)
