body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=241095%2E444211%2E-fS7tZ)
This morning Aimee shared some news: Powered by People just crossed reaching 100,000 voters. I've been thinking about that number all day.
When we started doing this work, a lot of “smart” people told me it was a waste of time. “Young people don't vote. Texas is too big. You can't win this state one conversation at a time.” I understood why they said it. I just never believed it.
100,000 sounds like a big, abstract number, but it isn't. It's made up of moments of people talking face to face and connecting as human beings without a screen in between them.
I like where we are. The polls are moving our way in the races for Senate and Governor. But this isn't a done deal.
Five days from now, on October 5th, voter registration closes. Between now and then I'll be on as many campuses as we can reach, and so will our volunteers.
[**If you're able, would you make a contribution before midnight to help keep us out here through Election Day?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260930-2.tHb50L&refcode=ema20260930-241095&t=3&akid=241095%2E444211%2E-fS7tZ)
Whatever you're able to do, thank you. I mean that. None of these 100,000 conversations happen without people like you.
Beto

#
The clock is winding down, Peter.
**Tonight, we face the last end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before voters make their voices heard in the 2026 midterms.**
Small Town PAC’s 2026 slate is up against a lot this November. From MAGA billionaire megadonors to corporate super PACs funneling millions behind their Republican opponents, our Democratic candidates need your help to make sure they have the resources to fight back.
Tim Walz and our team are working _every day_ to expand the map and take power back for working-class people in Washington. We know communities in every corner of the country who are tired of being overlooked and exploited by modern-day robber barons, and they’re ready for a new generation of leaders who will finally give them the representation they deserve.
With only 34 days until the election, reaching our final end-of-quarter goal will keep us on track for the critical final stretch. But fundraising has been slow this September, and if we fall short, we risk losing out on electing the leaders our small towns desperately need.
**So, before the clock strikes midnight, will you chip in $5 or whatever you can to help us reach our $60,000 goal? Tim asked us to make this personal link just for you:**
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-20260930-PM?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260930-PM.UWBwM-&amount=5&refcode=em20260930-1160&t=1&akid=1160%2E34582%2Eh-yNdx)**
Thank you,
TimWalz.com

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260930-1160-&t=2&refcode2=1160_34582_h-yNdx&akid=1160%2E34582%2Eh-yNdx)**

# **Iran wants Americans to vote Democrat**
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps released a 26-page letter **[urging Americans to vote out Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/34b19fbe-7ed7-4f93-afb5-a65ad626379a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and other Republican leaders, calling Trump a "tyrant" and arguing voters bear responsibility for U.S. government actions since they empower it through elections.

---
@upholdreality
https://t.co/NRikiLW7HZ
| 11:32 AM * Sep 29, 2026 * 1.48M Views151 Replies * 1.12K Reposts * 4.15K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/74791a2a-d991-4f66-a395-9268e02e57c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **The letter claimed anti-Israel sentiment is rising among Americans,** citing recent Democratic primary wins by left-wing candidates critical of Israel, including Darializa Avila Chevalier in New York and Melat Kiros in Colorado, both of whom unseated longtime incumbents.
* **The IRGC warned of a "massive economic earthquake" and global unrest against U.S. interests** if Washington doesn't change course, while insisting its "Death to America" rhetoric targets the government rather than the American people themselves.

# **Hidden cam shows James Talarico saying his position on trans kids "hasn't changed"**
An undercover recording from a Houston church shows Texas Senate candidate James Talarico telling a woman he'd **[continue defending the transgender agenda](https://substack.com/redirect/44012d65-a7d7-4e95-9bee-2b69f52c62cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as he did in the legislature, saying his position "hasn't changed" despite recent public statements suggesting a shift.

| 6:14 PM * Sep 29, 2026 * 154K Views92 Replies * 748 Reposts * 1.32K Likes

* **The comments came days after Talarico told Fox News he 'd oppose transgender athletes in girls' sports** if it compromised safety or fairness, and pledged support for a federal ban on gender-transition surgeries for minors -- a reversal from his past legislative votes and rhetoric.
* **A Texas Democratic Party staffer suggested in separate footage that Talarico is moderating his messaging** to appeal to a broader electorate while privately holding his earlier views, a characterization Paxton's campaign seized on as confirmation of his "radical record."

# **Hero passenger who subdued Flydubai hijacking suspect meets Netanyahu**
Yaniv Hayoun, one of the passengers who helped restrain the alleged co-pilot hijacker on Wednesday's Flydubai flight, **[met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/56d5ce04-6176-485c-a430-578c895ae135?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at Ben Gurion Airport still wearing his bloodstained shirt.

* **Hayoun said he had to briefly take control of the plane himself,** drawing on knowledge from watching the aviation disaster series "Mayday," until one of two off-duty pilots aboard took over and helped land the plane safely.
* **Netanyahu praised Hayoun and the other passengers as heroes** who prevented a "serious tragedy," after the suspect allegedly attacked the flight's captain with a knife before the captain managed to alert the cabin and open the cockpit door.

# **DOJ indicts 10 foreign nationals for voter fraud in Minnesota**
The Department of Justice charged 10 lawful permanent residents **[with federal voter fraud](https://substack.com/redirect/6b49f3f7-90e3-4f49-8293-84a689c2eada?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in Minnesota, alleging illegal voting or false citizenship claims spanning the 2022 and 2024 general elections and the August 2026 primary, Attorney General Todd Blanche announced.
[| | | | | U.S. Department of Justice
---
@TheJusticeDept
. @AGToddBlanche announces indictments against 10 Aliens for Voter Fraud in Minnesota who allegedly illegally voted in the November 2022 and 2024 General Election and the August 2026 Primary Election. ⬇️
| 3:47 PM * Sep 30, 2026 * 96.1K Views118 Replies * 435 Reposts * 1.59K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/310f2029-f31d-4eef-be88-c6aa3f1012e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Blanche emphasized that only U.S. citizens may vote in American elections,** framing enforcement as a nonpartisan legal issue, while DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin warned that noncitizens who vote illegally will face arrest, prosecution, and deportation.
* **Among those charged:** a Liberian woman accused of falsely claiming citizenship to register in 2024, a Lithuanian woman accused of illegally voting in 2022, and a Ghanaian man facing multiple counts for allegedly voting illegally and falsely claiming citizenship across both the 2024 election and this year's primary.

It’s urgent.
#

Hi friends,
I wasn’t planning on emailing you again, but this was time-sensitive.
Our final end-of-quarter deadline before the election is at 11:59 pm tonight. I just checked our ActBlue, and we need to raise another **$1,259** to reach our ambitious fundraising goal.
Hitting this goal would allow GIFFORDS to run another round of ads and reach even more undecided voters before early voting begins. So I’m asking:

$5 because gun violence still takes thousands of innocent lives every year.
$5 because we have the tools to help stop this crisis, but we need politicians who have the courage to stand up to the gun industry.
$5 because the election is in less than 5 weeks, and we need more resources to rebut the attacks and win back a gun sense majority.
I know $5 doesn’t sound like it has the power to do all that. But if even half of the people reading this chipped in $5, we could expand our outreach to persuadable voters and beat back the gun lobby’s attacks. _**Will you help start that chain reaction?**_

Their goal is simple: buy the politicians who will let them pave over, clear-cut, and mine our public lands. At midnight tonight, our most critical end-of-quarter fundraising deadline hits. When the sun comes up tomorrow, we either have the war chest to keep funding our surgical digital ad blitzes, or we let them buy our national heritage without a fight. They think their campaign checks can buy our backyard. Let's make sure it costs them their seats. You take our land—we take your seat. It's what has helped us reach out to voters in our campaigns for State Representative and Attorney General and spread our message throughout Oregon.

**It's also what makes us different from other campaigns.** We're able to take on corporate special interests when others can't because we know you all will have our backs.

And that's something that I'm extremely proud of.

Having campaigns that are built on trust means a lot to me. That's why when our campaign shows up for folks, they show up in return.

_**But, Peter, our movement's support is going to be put to the test soon.**_

| | | | Since taking office as Oregon’s Attorney General in 2025, Dan Rayfield has focused on protecting Oregon’s working families and homegrown small businesses by taking on pharmaceutical companies, polluters, and large corporations driving up costs for groceries and other everyday needs. He’s been fighting hard to block the Trump Administration from taking away the rights of Oregonians, suing Trump–and winning–dozens of times.

[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/fjFKC5vP5Ue?e=1768325bd4&c2id=0fcd3a526fabf816bd24466788989260)

Dan grew up in Oregon and is a product of the Oregon public school system. Following his graduation from Tigard High School, Dan attended Western Oregon University and then earned his law degree from Willamette University College of Law. In 2005, prior to his law school graduation, he clerked for the Benton County District Attorney’s office. During his time at the District Attorney’s office, he gained his first trial experience prosecuting DUIs and other misdemeanor charges. Dan has also served as a coach attorney for the OSU Mock Trial Team, a former Linn County Peer Court Judge, and Past President of the Linn-Benton Bar Association.

Since 2015, Dan served as the State Representative for Oregon House District 16, which encompasses the cities of Corvallis and Philomath, and Oregon State University. In 2022, he was elected by his colleagues to serve as Speaker of the House. Over that time, he helped lead the way on issues including a high quality education for our children, access to affordable and reliable healthcare, making sure families are able to earn a living wage while simultaneously nurturing innovation and supporting Oregon’s small businesses, and making our public safety system more effective and accountable. Dan lives in Corvallis with his wife Amanda and their son Adam.

**Prefer to donate via mail? Address a check to:**

PO Box 42307
Portland, OR 97242

body:
The most important thing we can do is make sure Democrats win the midterm elections.
Dear Peter,
In just a few hours, Truth to Power will face our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before Election Day. Right now, we are still $5,036 short of our goal.
I’ll explain more below, but if you’re ready to help us flip Congress, **[click here to chip in $5.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260930_1_ak.5tTTh-&refcode=em20260930-41589&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=41589%2E3422442%2EQhoSAj)**
I’ve spent my entire career fighting for working families, so I can say with confidence _the most important thing we can do in that fight today is make sure Democrats win the midterm elections._
If we take back the majority in the House and Senate, then the champions we’re supporting on our [2026 slate](https://act.katieporter.com/go/22173?t=2&akid=41589%2E3422442%2EQhoSAj) can get to work fighting for everyday people.
But our opponents won’t make this easy. **Giant corporations love that Trump is making them richer while we pay the price, and their PACs are spending huge amounts to tip the scales in the GOP’s favor.**
That’s where we come in. **While our opponents court corporate PAC donations, we give our slate a surge of grassroots support to get them over the finish line.**
Our end-of-quarter goal dictates how much we can budget for our slate in these final weeks. _We have to reach this goal_ to make sure they have the resources they need to win.
I’m counting on you to help us close our $5,036 fundraising gap, Peter. If you’re with me, **[click here to pitch in $5—or any amount that makes sense to you—toward our goal.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260930_1_ak.5tTTh-&refcode=em20260930-41589&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41589%2E3422442%2EQhoSAj)**
I am so grateful for your support.
Thank you,
Katie Porter

On top of that, Greg Abbott recently unleashed $12 million on attack ads.

**Abbott can easily keep spending like this.** But we can only stay in the fight if people like you step up, Peter.

name: Derek Tran
subject: last one from me this quarter
body:
One more note before the quarter closes tonight.Hi there,
Our last quarterly deadline before Election Day hits at midnight, and this is my final email before it does, so I'll keep it short.
Michelle and I have been through plenty of quarter-ends at our pharmacy. When you own a small business, the last day of the quarter is when you find out whether you can do everything you planned for the next few months, or whether something has to give.
Today is that day for this campaign. Whatever we've raised by midnight is what we'll have for the last five weeks of this race. After tonight, there isn't another quarter to make it up.
Ballots start arriving in mailboxes across CA-45 next week. I want to walk into October knowing we can reach voters from Cerritos to Westminster to Fullerton before they fill theirs out.
If you're able, will you chip in $3 before midnight to help me finish this quarter where I need to be?

Derek

body:
34 days, Peter.

That’s all we have left between now and Election Day.

We have a critical deadline coming up at midnight tonight, and it’s one of
our most important ones yet — the last end-of-quarter deadline before
November.

Whatever gets reported tonight is the number that our endorsed candidates’
opponents will be looking at heading into the last stretch of the
midterms. Why? Because they know that Leaders We Deserve backs our
candidates with everything we’ve got.

This money goes to support candidates like:

Kristina Knickerbocker, an Air Force veteran and Nurse Practitioner,
running in Ohio’s 10th Congressional District. She’s challenging
Republican Mike Turner who ignored his constituents' pleas and voted for
Trump's “Big Beautiful Bill” which has put hundreds of thousands of
Ohioans at risk of losing Medicaid coverage.

Brad Chambers is running in PA House District 41, a seat essential to
expanding the slim majority Democrats have in the Pennsylvania House.
Expanding this majority allows House Democrats to pass more life-changing
legislation in support of working families.

Trevor Jung is running in Wisconsin for SD-21, one of the most competitive
state senate seats in the country. This is a must win seat for Democrats
to gain a majority in the WI State Senate and ensure the next stop on
Trump's redistricting campaign is not Wisconsin.

Those are just three of the bold, young candidates we are supporting in
competitive races around the country to win back state legislative power
for Democrats and flip Congress. Some races will be decided by just a few
thousand or even a few hundred votes. That means we can’t afford to show
the National Republicans and mega-donors watching anything but the
strength of this people-powered movement.

Every dollar we’re raising and every campaign we power without taking a
single cent of corporate PAC money tells a story about our momentum, our
resolve, and whether the corporations bankrolling our candidates’
opponents should be worried. I want them worried. Because this country
doesn’t need anymore leaders that play it safe and hope no one notices. It
needs a genuine opposition who will stand up to Trump’s dangerous agenda,
break the GOP’s grip on power, and finally give people something to
believe in again.

That’s why we really need your support right now. This is one of our last
chances to make a bold statement about what’s coming in these final 34
days.

If you’ve been waiting for a good moment to chip in, this is the time. And
if you’ve already given, THANK YOU — it means more than you know. If you
can, please make a contribution to keep our work going strong:
[ https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260930_2_final.aH_9fW&refcode=em20260930-4085&amount=3&t=1001&akid=4085%2E587540%2EfPSW2R ]https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20260930_2_final

Thank you for your support.

— David

If you can, please make a contribution to keep our work going strong: [ ] Thank you for your support. — David

Tomorrow, I’ll be recording our first radio commercial, which is scheduled to hit the airwaves **Monday, October 5** , starting on **KLH and The Hog**. The equation is pretty simple: **more money means more airtime and more voters hearing our message.**
Our video campaign is also underway. We have **two new videos on the Beck for Congress[ website](https://gbw1f.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBnCiEKhmxTFyzImlN/K-lAr6Xwk6R7 "https://www.beckforcongress.com/")** for your viewing pleasure, another running as a Meta ad, and more coming next week. Please watch them, share them, and help us get them in front of as many people as possible.
And toward the end of October, **BFC billboards will start going up around the district.** Radio, video, digital advertising and billboards all help build name recognition—but, yes, they also cost money. Every contribution helps us keep the message moving.

I’ve spent the last few days trying to find a way out, and I’ve finally reached the point where I have to humble myself and ask for help. - I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t urgent, but time is ticking. I hope you’ll understand. Best, Katie Britt | Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc.

**Today is no ordinary day on the road to flip an Alabama House seat from red to blue.****

All the days leading to the mid-term election have been filled with both challenge and opportunity. The challenge of fighting for real change in how Alabama families are represented in Washington. The opportunity to meet and truly listen to families about what matters most to them.**But today is not just any day.**

My Republican opponent Dale Strong’s also been counting - counting his corporate PAC checks. He's sitting on over $1.3 million from lobbyists and special interests. I've raised every dollar from real people like you. That’s how much the people believe in what we want to achieve.
**With your contribution before midnight tonight, you’re standing up to be counted** as a force for change in Alabama.
**Thank you for making this day an extraordinary one – please chip in $25, $10, or whatever y****ou can toward our goal of raising $5,000 by midnight!**

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: A question I never thought I would be asking you today:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
If it makes sense for your budget, would you [contribute your first-ever $5 before tonight’s deadline to power our campaign for reelection?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260930-2.WCSyTx&refcode=em20260930-12377-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=12377%2E2526796%2E7ptgTl)
If you told me a decade ago that I would be asking you this question today, I probably would not have believed you. I might have even laughed.
Nine years ago, I was working as a waitress while organizing my community. It was only a few months into Donald Trump’s presidency when I decided to take the leap and launch a long-shot campaign against a 10-term incumbent.
I had 3 million dollars spent against me in that primary election. But still we were able to win.
The pollsters and the consultants, about a week before primary day, said I was down by 35 points.
I appreciate numbers, but when I saw that number I knew it was wrong. I could just feel that their numbers were off. When I was outside talking to my neighbors, what I was hearing did not align with what the pollsters were saying before my primary.
The poll that had me down 35 points had a lot of assumptions about who they thought would vote in my community in The Bronx and Queens. I knew that I was running a different kind of campaign, to change who the kind of people who voted were.
That year, we worked, we organized, we gave people who had previously been left behind a reason to vote and made the impossible possible together. _We won._
But that race was only the beginning.
In the years since we shocked the political establishment with our very first victory, this movement has grown even stronger – and that is because of the dedication and support of people like you.
Together, we have shared a vision for America where a better future is possible. Where a dignified life is not just a dream, but a norm. And in just 34 days, we have another critical opportunity to expand our coalition of progressive Democrats who will fight unapologetically for issues like a living wage, universal child care, and Medicare for All.
Representing our movement in Washington has changed my life in innumerable ways – and I see it as my honor and my responsibility to use every day I am in office to fight to change yours, too.
[ That is why I am asking you – if, and only if it makes sense for you today – to consider making a $5 donation before tonight’s end-of-quarter deadline. Every donation we receive before midnight will help elect not just me, but many more Democratic candidates who will fight to transform our country.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260930-2.WCSyTx&refcode=em20260930-12377-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=12377%2E2526796%2E7ptgTl)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260930-2.WCSyTx&refcode=em20260930-12377-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=12377%2E2526796%2E7ptgTl)**
I know contributing to a political campaign is a luxury not everyone who reads these emails can always afford. So whether or not you decide to donate today, please know that I am grateful.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

**[Donate](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260930-2.WCSyTx&refcode=em20260930-12377-P_FND_EGR_GRM&t=1&akid=12377%2E2526796%2E7ptgTl)** | **[Merch](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/9251?utm_source=em-footer-20260930-12377-P_FND_EGR_GRM&t=2&akid=12377%2E2526796%2E7ptgTl)**

Friend, Last week, an ICE agent shot a DoorDash driver in Austin, a 28-year-old man delivering food. They left him with a bullet in his torso, pulling him out of the hospital to put him in a detention facility that gave him Tylenol and ibuprofen. His lawyer says he wasn't properly treated for the wound for over a day. The shooting is now under federal investigation. We don't yet have all the facts about what happened. But we already know how my opponent will respond, because he's told us. After fatal ICE shootings earlier this year, he posted simply, "I stand with ICE." An agency operating with poorly trained agents and no real interest in accountability isn't protecting anyone. It's putting all of us, including immigrants doing their jobs, at risk. I spent years working on congressional oversight because I believe powerful people should have to answer to the public for their actions. Congress needs watchdogs who will demand answers, not lapdogs who will allow this rogue agency to go unchecked. **[Tonight is our final end-of-quarter reporting deadline before the election. They left him with a bullet in his torso, pulling him out of the hospital to put him in a detention facility that gave him Tylenol and ibuprofen. His lawyer says he wasn't properly treated for the wound for over a day. The shooting is now under federal investigation. We don't yet have all the facts about what happened. But we already know how my opponent will respond, because he's told us. After fatal ICE shootings earlier this year, he posted simply, "I stand with ICE." An agency operating with poorly trained agents and no real interest in accountability isn't protecting anyone. It's putting all of us, including immigrants doing their jobs, at risk. **About Senator John Hoeven** A North Dakota native born in Bismarck, John Hoeven has spent his career fighting for the people of the Peace Garden State. Before coming to Washington, he served **ten years as North Dakota's governor** — growing the economy, cutting taxes, and turning North Dakota into one of the nation's top energy producers.

Since being sworn in as U.S. Senator in 2011, Hoeven has brought that same commonsense approach to Washington. He's a leading voice for **American energy dominance** , a champion for North Dakota's farmers and ranchers, and a tireless defender of our military — including Minot Air Force Base, the nation's only dual-nuclear base.

John and his wife Mikey call Bismarck home. He's fighting every day to keep North Dakota strong and America first.
